title: push: a Console served from a host with an underscore or a trailing dot has its whole native push registration refused (400); the spec docblock says the producer leaves `origin` out for such a host, and it does not
body:
domain:spec#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2eAG5J8aqAyPZif4BJ

Filing gate: ① a spec docblock that is false against its one producer, found by the post-hoc spec review #31467 (`Reviewed:` line on that card for PR #30705 / #29768).
Reader: triage routes it. The behaviour fix is `domain:ui` (`ui/apps/console/src/nativePushRegistration.ts`). The prose-only fallback is `domain:spec` (`packages/spec/src/system/push-server-origin.ts`).
Dedupe (open AND closed): "push origin underscore registration" → no hit on this defect.
reach: a self-hosted Console whose hostname has an underscore (common in internal DNS) or a trailing dot. Its device registration is refused whole, so that device gets no pushes at all. The spec says the device registers with no origin.
type: Bug

## Readings (`origin/main` 3c380253e)

- Spec (PR #30705 hunk, `push-server-origin.ts` ≈L36-40): "the producer leaves `origin` out for such a host; that device's pushes then carry no origin." The pattern (≈L54-55) admits labels `[a-z0-9-]` only.
- Producer: `registrationOrigin()` (`ui/apps/console/src/nativePushRegistration.ts` ≈L141-142) returns `location.origin` for ANY http/https page, with no pattern guard. The body sends it at ≈L167-174 (this predates #30705; #30534).
- Door: `runtime/domains/notifications.ts:214` safe-parses the whole body, so a non-matching `origin` yields a 400 and the registration is lost.

## Ask

Make the prose true by fixing the producer: `registrationOrigin()` returns `undefined` when `location.origin` fails the spec's exported origin pattern, so the device registers without an origin, as the docblock says. Add a console test for an underscore host and a trailing-dot host. If the producer is not changed, reword the spec docblock to say that such a registration is refused.
